title: App Migration
purpose: All Customers off Resident Portal and on the Homebody app by Dec 10, 2026, in waves. Cohort 1 is the first wave. This page holds the waves, their schedules, how a CSM or Sales asks for an exception, and the path from 225K to 3M residents on Pay.

sections.title: Waves
sections.body: Cohort 1 (60 clients) is wave 1; Christian's list is linked under References, and per-client status is not in the repo yet. The remaining waves are not defined here. Christian: add a table with one row per wave (clients, units, start, go-live, status) and, for Cohort 1, per-client status (scheduled, migrating, live, blocked). The 'Customers still on Resident Portal' tile is the denominator for the whole program.

sections.title: Greystar is already live on the Homebody app
sections.body: Greystar rolled out ahead of Cohort 1: GIG, GMS, and Student Living were live by September (596 properties, 166,969 units), with Senior Living (172 properties, 30,524 units) scheduled for the week of Sep 7. The first wave of 407 properties migrated in five days during June rent week. Use it as the reference for what a large-client migration looks like and what to tell Cohort 1 clients to expect. Highlights page is under References (GitHub sign-in required).

sections.title: What Greystar taught us, for every wave
rows: Late Apr → May 4–6
Go-live dates were set in late April; property details (branding, links, media, app settings) for 407 properties arrived May 4–6, leaving Engineering about two weeks to build.
A client data dependency, not a build problem. Engineering built, validated, staged, and migrated with zero slip.
Collect each wave's clients' branding, links, media, and app settings at scheduling time, not two weeks before go-live.
Jul 22 · GMS
Amenity 'Confirm and Pay' screen was blank; residents could not pay for a reservation.
A security key left over from Greystar's previous custom resident app was still in the account after migration.
Add 'clear prior-app credentials and keys' to the migration checklist for any client coming off a custom app.
Jul 17 and 28 · GIG, GMS
'Forgot password' sent no email at two properties.
About 500 accounts sat on a lease attached to a property ID that does not exist, so there was no valid property to send from.
Validate lease-to-property integrity before go-live; bad property data looks like a login outage to residents.
Aug 17 · Grand Peaks → GMS
Deposit Alternative policies cancelled when properties transferred.
Expected policy on an operator change, not an outage.
Tell clients up front what happens to HBG and Deposit Alternative coverage when a property changes operator.
Sep 1–3 · Student Living
Residents saw 'Homebody is not available at this property.'
A temporary contract expired Aug 31 and the product was switched off overnight.
Check contract end dates against go-live and rent-week dates; a commercial flag reads as a product failure to the resident.
sections.note: Each report arrived as a Homebody bug and none was one. Source: Greystar × Homebody — Migration Status & Learnings, updated Sep 3, 2026.
